options.title: Dyson Built {fact1} Vacuums Before One Worked
options.first_line: James Dyson built {fact1} vacuum cleaners before a single one of them worked.
options.first_frame: A Dyson DC01 standing on a floor, the camera pushing in, as the prototype count starts climbing over it in big white figures.

options.title: James Dyson Failed {fact1} Times. Then He Got Rich
options.first_line: James Dyson failed {fact1} times at building one vacuum cleaner, and that is how he got rich.
options.first_frame: A black-and-white polaroid of James Dyson dropping onto a dark desk, the failure count stamped beside it.

options.title: The Vacuum That Failed {fact1} Times Became Dyson
options.first_line: The vacuum in millions of homes failed {fact1} times before it ever worked.
options.first_frame: A modern Dyson vacuum in a hallway, the count of failed prototypes slamming in over it.

why: It opens on the vacuum already in millions of homes and asks how something that failed so many times became Dyson, without giving away the turn, while B gives the ending away and A is close but less about the viewer's own home.
